question: What practice is said to have been told to the addressee, and to whom is this statement directed?
premises: This practice of the soul is the thing referred to.
It has been told to you.
The statement is addressed to Bhairavī.
The particle 'ca' connects elements of the address.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: No details of the practice are given by these tokens alone.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
